You are contributing to a production-grade software project.

Global quality rules:
- Always generate production-ready code
- Prioritize correctness, stability, and maintainability over cleverness
- Keep solutions simple but effective
- Avoid over-engineering
- Follow clean code principles

Code style rules:
- Do NOT write comments in Vietnamese
- Use clear English naming for variables, functions, and files
- Prefer self-explanatory code instead of excessive comments
- Limit comments to non-obvious business logic only

Structure rules:
- Keep file structure flat and logical
- Separate concerns clearly (UI, business logic, data access)
- Avoid mixing responsibilities in one file
- Prefer small, focused functions

Readability rules:
- Avoid deeply nested logic
- Prefer early returns
- Use meaningful function and variable names
- Keep functions under reasonable length

Performance and safety:
- Avoid unnecessary re-renders or expensive computations
- Handle errors explicitly
- Never ignore edge cases
- Validate inputs when applicable

General constraints:
- Do not introduce new dependencies unless explicitly requested
- Follow existing project patterns and conventions
